title: Helping a store
summary: KloudC masters: how to handle a support email, what you can see, and what you must never ask for.

items: Read the email for the Store ID, the page, and what happened. Ask for a screenshot if there isn't one.
Check the store's status on **Stores** and recent events on **Audit** (for example failed sign-ins or a failed sync).
Point to the right guide or answer in the Help Center when it covers the question.

If you need to see what the store sees, start a **support session**: a short sign-in as one of the store's users (30 minutes by default, 2 hours at most), with a reason. The reason goes in the audit log.
Reply with what you found and what you changed.

blocks.text: Never ask anyone for their password. Passwords are reset by the store's own admins on Users.

items: Masters can't read connection keys. The store's admin re-enters a key on Integrations.
A locked login unlocks by itself after 15 minutes.
Store data is the store's. Look only at what the support case needs.
